name: Étan

attributes.attribute: daughter of the healer god Dian Cécht
wife of Ogma, the god of eloquence

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Étan is an Irish goddess of crafts. People often confuse her with Étain. Étan is the daughter of Dian Cécht, the healer god. She is the wife of Ogma, the god of eloquence. Other minor figures bear the same name. One of them is a mistress of the hero Cúchulainn.

okr.objective: Étan is an Irish goddess of crafts.
key_results: Étan is a crafts goddess and the daughter of the healer god Dian Cécht.
She is the wife of Ogma, the god of eloquence.
Other minor figures, including one mistress of Cúchulainn, share the name.
People often confuse Étan with Étain.
